title: HPSM-POC: name the Security SME and a deputy Product Owner (HPSMPOC-6)?
bluf: Reply with a name for the deputy Product Owner, or tap a. The Product Owner is you (HPSMPOC-6 comment 2026-09-23, C-05) and the Security SME is read as you too; no deputy exists anywhere (HPSMPOC-6 comment 2026-09-27; word "deputy" appears 0 times in the analysis repo CLARIFICATIONS.md, read 2026-10-19). The ticket says the PO must decide within one business day (HPSMPOC-6 description, SOW 7.3), so when you are away nobody can. The ticket has been Backlog since 2026-09-27 (HPSMPOC-6 status/updated). Naming people is yours.

options.label: Keep you as PO and SME; name a deputy PO (reply with the name)
options.detail: SME stays you, as C-05 reads it today. You send one name for the deputy PO; the records seat writes it into the clarifications log and HPSMPOC-6, and the ticket closes.

options.label: Name both: an SME and a deputy PO (reply with the names)
options.detail: Use this if someone other than you should be the Security SME. Records seat writes both and closes HPSMPOC-6.

options.label: Keep you as PO and SME, no deputy
options.detail: Record that decisions wait for you when you are away; the one-business-day line in the SOW is accepted as best effort. Closes HPSMPOC-6 as decided.

default_action: Nothing changes: you remain PO and SME with no deputy, and HPSMPOC-6 stays open in Backlog. Tuesday re-raises at the next HP-facing milestone.
_override_prior: the only shared subject word is the date suffix 1019 in the card id; no match is on this ticket or subject (prior rulings for this subject searched by the drafter: none, CARDS-REPORT.md)
